C0957.title: Illegal Sale of Unregistered SIM Cards, Offline and Online Promotion for Real-Name Verification, and SIM Bank Authentication: 19 Individuals Prosecuted
C0957.summary: Reported on February 24, 2023, 19 individuals were publicly prosecuted for infringing on citizens' personal information. The group illegally sold unregistered SIM cards, induced others to complete real-name verification through offline and online promotion, and used SIM bank devices to receive verification codes in bulk, providing verified mobile cards and accounts for downstream cybercrimes.
